name: setup
cost: Free and open source (MIT). Claude usage, optional keys and cloud renders can cost money
works_with: Claude Code. Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Copilot through `npx skills`
short: Gets the cooked. AI video editor running: installs Python, ffmpeg, Node, a transcription model and the renderer, then saves your editing style.
what: This is the setup skill for cooked., an editor that cuts your talking-head video in the style of 3 to 6 example videos. On a first run it opens the editor's window in your browser and installs everything in the background: Python packages, ffmpeg, Node, git, a free local transcription model and the Remotion renderer. Then it walks you through optional Gemini and ElevenLabs keys and cloud renders, and asks about your style once.
who: Creators who want an AI editor for talking-head videos and don't mind a big install. It's written for people who may never have used a terminal. You need Claude Code, or another agent with a shell.
needs: Claude Code and a Claude account (a paid plan or an API key)
A Mac, Windows or Linux computer with internet
About 1.5 GB of space for the tools, most of it the renderer
Optional: Gemini and ElevenLabs API keys
Optional: a Modal, GitHub or AWS account for cloud renders

steps.title: Install the plugin
steps.text: Inside Claude Code. If it asks, type `/reload-plugins`.

steps.title: Or use another agent
steps.text: The skills share code across the repo, so if your agent copies single skill folders, clone the whole repo too.

steps.title: Run setup
steps.text: Say "set up the editor", or press Start setup in the editor's window. It checks your computer and installs what's missing. Anything that needs your password, you paste into your own terminal.

steps.title: Add keys, or skip them
steps.text: Never paste a key into the chat. Setup saves it from your clipboard and sends one free test request. Say "finish setup" later to add a key you skipped.

steps.title: Open the editor
steps.text: When the doctor check prints `Ready.`, open the editor from any terminal:

try.label: From the README
try.text: Paste 3 to 6 links to videos edited the same way and press Analyse this format. Then drop in your clip, or pick Use the sample take, and press Make my video.

watch: It installs a lot: about 1.5 GB, including a 500 MB transcription model and about 700 MB for the renderer.
Remotion is free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people. Bigger companies need a Remotion company licence.
Keys are kept in `~/.config/creator-teardown/.env`, readable only by you.
Everything runs on your computer unless you pick a cloud render. Modal's Starter plan includes $30 of free credit a month, and AWS Lambda costs money on your own account.
If your Mac has no Homebrew, setup gives you Homebrew's install script to run in your own terminal. Read it before you run it.
How much of your Claude plan a video uses hasn't been measured yet.
